Class HomeController

java.lang.Object
com.codependentvariables.aiandme.controller.HomeController

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the dashboard view and loads all user analytics data.

      This includes:

      • User check-in streak information
      • Recent check-in line chart data
      • Recent quiz attempt scores
      • Quiz/puzzle category pie chart statistics
      • Recommended quizzes and puzzles
      Applies dynamic styling based on the current theme.

    • navigateCheckIn

      public void navigateCheckIn(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent mouseEvent)
      Navigates the user to the daily check-in page. Guest users can always access the check-in page. Logged-in users are prevented from completing multiple check-ins on the same day.
      Parameters:
      mouseEvent - mouse click event triggered by the user

    • handleAttemptQuiz
